title: AnnoyanceMod
description: A Minecraft Mod that Makes Minecraft extremely annoying by changing game features, adding confusing aspects to the game, and making normal features hilariously weird.
body:
Ever thought Minecraft wasn’t annoying enough? This mod fixes that. It is designed for players who laugh through pain. FerrettMC’s Annoying Chaos turns your world into a slapstick survival nightmare.
 
Core Features

Random Holes — Dirt, stone, and even bedrock occasionally vanish beneath your feet.

Flying Stairs — Step on stairs and get launched.

Creeper Vision Explosion — Simply seeing a Creeper triggers an instant kaboom. You don’t even have to get close.

Mike Tyson Boxing Ring — Press a button to find out.

Reversed Knockback — Hit mobs? You fly backward instead.
